author: /root/ci_review
change_scope: New v02 collector + focused stdlib fixtures only; v01 and canonical workflow/source untouched.
Import-safe main preserves API/repository/branch/workflow/source/attempt/completed-job/artifact-size/digest guards, and binds artifacts to exact unique job names and step names.

Increase only artifact member cap from5000 to50000: frozen source has19702tracked paths,5802test-resultXML files and680build/report files. Retain64MiB compressed/artifact,512MiB combined,256MiB expanded/archive,128MiB expanded/file; log limits remain1500members/64MiB expanded/file/128MiB compressed.

All table paths/types/duplicate/file-directory-prefix checks run before every member streams to EOF for CRC and SHA; only then selected extraction with exclusive/nonredirected paths and second-pass SHA/byte checks.
Exact observed workspace prefix parlor/parlor/ and frozen Git-derived live output roots; tracked/historical/unknown paths never extracted as current reports.

API checkout+ownership step success admits only current-path review candidates, never test execution. Windows failed checkout has zero admitted live reports. Exact current-named receipts are retained even on job failure and require separate content/source/cleanup review.
Original compressed artifacts/logs kept, with every historical/opaque/unselected member in full validated table; no deletion, dispatch, retry, build, publication, or runtime result counting.
limitations: Collection/admission is not fresh test execution; runtime provenance requires current logs/tasks/source/receipt review.
Unknown artifact layouts stay compressed and explicitly unclassified rather than heuristically expanded.
Ownership/cleanup contents are not accepted as PASS by collection; independent interpretation remains required.
Oversized/bad archives fail closed; partial downloads and any failed collection receipt remain preserved.
Download byte limits, like v01, are checked after the bounded180-second gh process completes; metadata compressed sizes are checked before artifact download.
cleanup: No test/build/import execution or generated scratch outputs by author; root owns coordinated fixture stop/cleanup and collection.
